description: This file defines arithmetic operator overloads for the torch::lazy namespace, facilitating lazy evaluation of arithmetic operations in the PyTorch framework. It declares external operator functions for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division on nodes representing computation graph elements.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Function overload for addition of two Value nodes, returning a NodePtr representing the sum.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Function overload for subtraction of two Value nodes, returning a NodePtr representing the difference.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Function overload for multiplication of two Value nodes, returning a NodePtr representing the product.
Function overload for division of two Value nodes, returning a NodePtr representing the quotient.
